additions.why: Pack-years drive malignancy risk estimation for the nodule and eligibility for lung cancer screening.

evidence.quote: i stopped smoking probably about seven years ago

follow_up_questions.title: Constitutional and cancer symptoms
follow_up_questions.question: Have you had any coughing up of blood, unexplained weight loss, night sweats, fevers, or loss of appetite?
follow_up_questions.why: These red flags raise the suspicion of malignancy or infection and were not asked about for a 2 cm nodule.

follow_up_questions.title: Smoking pack-years and exposures
follow_up_questions.question: How many cigarettes a day did you smoke and for how many years? Any occupational exposures such as asbestos, or travel and TB or fungal exposure?
follow_up_questions.why: Pack-years and exposures help estimate malignancy risk and the differential diagnosis.

follow_up_questions.title: Perioperative methotrexate and allergies
follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any drug allergies, and do you take any other medicines or blood thinners? Should the methotrexate be held around the surgery, in coordination with your rheumatologist?
follow_up_questions.why: Allergies were not discussed, and immunosuppression affects surgical risk and wound healing before VATS.

follow_up_questions.title: Prior imaging and prior cancer
follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any older chest imaging for comparison, and have you ever had cancer yourself?
follow_up_questions.why: Nodule stability over time and prior malignancy change the risk assessment and the need for resection.
